title: University of Missouri Extension — Roses: Care After Planting (G6601)

common.applies_to: Hybrid Tea, Floribunda or Grandiflora rose; general care outside pruning
common.preserved_uncertainty: Soak "to a depth of at least 1 foot"; water "in the morning or early in the afternoon"; mulch "2 to 3 inches deep"; "Don't fertilize after July"; new plants: "leave as much foliage on the plant as possible"; mound "to a height of 10 to 12 inches"; black spot, powdery mildew, aphids, spider mites. The page doesn't contain F13's claim.
